opening.argument: The presentation explains blockchain oracles as infrastructure that connects outside information to blockchain networks and makes that information available at the right time. It identifies the subject as an explanation of blockchain oracles and Chainlink, and describes an oracle as a bridge between a blockchain and the outside world. References to data from many sources address data protection and reliability, while the smart-contract and game-status examples illustrate how information can be supplied to a blockchain. Although a financial-style chart appears, it is presented as illustrative and is not tied to a transaction request or financial outcome.

citations.quote: Blockchain Oracle is a tool that connects the outside data to the blockchain network.
it ensures that the data is available at the right time
It ensures that data is not being taken from just one source, but is being taken from many sources.
